timeframes.binance_alignment: all candles are Binance UTC-aligned; 1d/3d/1w/1mo open at 00:00 UTC, not NY midnight

pdh_pdl_validity.3m: valid: candle boundaries align with NY midnight under both EST and EDT
pdh_pdl_validity.5m: valid: candle boundaries align with NY midnight under both EST and EDT

pdh_pdl_validity.1h: valid: candle boundaries align with NY midnight under both EST and EDT
pdh_pdl_validity.2h: valid during EDT only; during EST the 23:00 NY candle (spanning midnight) is bucketed into the previous NY day (1h misalignment)
pdh_pdl_validity.4h: valid during EDT only; during EST the 23:00 NY candle (spanning midnight) is bucketed into the previous NY day (1h misalignment)

pdh_pdl_validity.1d: degenerate: every candle starts a new NY-day bucket, so pdh/pdl = previous candle high/low (UTC-aligned)
pdh_pdl_validity.3d: degenerate: every candle starts a new NY-day bucket, so pdh/pdl = previous candle high/low (UTC-aligned)

swing_high.index: swing_high[0] = most recently confirmed swing high as of t
swing_high.known_at: close of the candle AFTER the pivot (3-candle rule, strict >): pivot open_time + 1 candle

fvg.retention: last 512 (FvgTracker::kMaxActive), pruned after 50,000 candles; filled FVGs stay flagged
fvg.index: fvg[0] = most recently formed FVG as of t; views bullish_fvg[k] / bearish_fvg[k] filter by direction
fvg.known_at: close of C3 (confirmed_at candle); lifecycle flags at the close of the candle that changes them

order_block.retention: last 256 (OrderBlockTracker::kMaxActive); invalidated OBs stay flagged and stop updating
order_block.index: order_block[0] = most recently formed OB as of t; views bullish_ob[k] / bearish_ob[k]
order_block.known_at: close of the candle that completes the FVG+BOS pair after the anchor (standard/propulsion) or the swing-confirming candle (rejection)

structural_event.retention: event stream only (smc_update.structural_events); NOT in smc_snapshot
structural_event.index: structural_event[0] = most recent event as of t; unindexed refs inside one expression bind existentially to one event emitted at t
structural_event.known_at: close of the breaking/sweeping candle t (event)
